questions.q: Which of the following is an Anunasik (nasal) consonant?
questions.exp: The nasal consonants are ਙ, ਞ, ਣ, ਨ, ਮ. Mamma is nasal.

questions.q: How many letters are used as Dut Akhars (sub-joined letters) in Punjabi?
questions.exp: Only three letters are used as Dut Akhars: ਹ (Haha), ਰ (Rara), and ਵ (Vava).

questions.q: Which of these is a valid Dut Akhar in Gurmukhi?
questions.exp: Rara is a Dut Akhar. The three are ਹ, ਰ, ਵ.

questions.q: What is the name of the 'Ka' varg consonants?
How many nasal consonants (Anunasik) are there in Gurmukhi?
questions.exp: There are five: ਙ, ਞ, ਣ, ਨ, ਮ.

opts: At the foot of a letter
At the end of a word
questions.exp: They are sub-joined, meaning written at the foot of another letter.

questions.q: Which of the following words correctly uses a Dut Akhar?
questions.exp: ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ uses the Dut Akhar 'ਰ' under the 'ਪ'.
It belongs to the Pa varg (Labial).
